description: This file handles SEC Form 4 data, including fetching, parsing, caching, and database management for SEC filings related to company ownership transactions.

methods.name: get_logger
methods.description: Initializes and returns a logger for SEC-related logs.

methods.name: setup_database
methods.description: Creates the SQLite table for caching Form 4 data.

methods.name: add_missing_column
methods.description: Adds a missing column to the database table with an inferred data type.

methods.name: compress_db
methods.description: Compresses the database file using gzip.

methods.name: close_db
methods.description: Sorts and closes the database, then compresses it.

methods.name: get_form_4_urls
methods.description: Fetches URLs for SEC Form 4 filings for a given symbol within optional date range.

methods.name: clean_xml
methods.description: Cleans XML content by removing backslashes and fixing ampersands.

methods.name: get_form_4_data
methods.description: Retrieves and parses Form 4 XML data from SEC URL.

methods.name: parse_form_4_data
methods.description: Parses the raw Form 4 data into structured records.

methods.name: download_data
methods.description: Downloads, caches, and processes multiple Form 4 URLs asynchronously.

methods.name: get_cached_data
methods.description: Retrieves cached Form 4 data from SQLite database.

methods.name: get_form_4
methods.description: Main function to get Form 4 data for a symbol or CIK, with optional date range and limit.
